description: Read the signed-in user's OWN data-model graph — the public standards in this build (MATCH (r:DmeStandardRoot) RETURN r._source names them) plus the user's private :UserContent additions, isolated to their workspace. Use these to inspect what the user has built and to find standard elements (by stableId) to link new nodes to.
_note: No startup needed. POSTs over HTTP to the educore executor (/api/dme-user-cypher-query) using server-internal auth from env (DME_API_BASE, DME_INTERNAL_SECRET, DME_VERSION_REF_ID). User mode only.

definition.name: dme_user_query
definition.description: Run a READ-ONLY Cypher query against the user's isolated graph (golden standards + the user's :UserContent nodes). Returns rows. The user's own nodes carry :UserContent and a userNodeId; standard elements are :ForgedNode nodes carrying a stableId (link targets are those in roles DmeClass, DmeProperty, DmeOptionSet, DmeOptionValue). Example: MATCH (n:UserContent) RETURN n.name, n.userNodeId LIMIT 25

query.description: A read-only Cypher query (MATCH/RETURN). Writes are rejected; use the write tools to change the graph.

definition.name: dme_user_schema
definition.description: Return the schema (labels, relationship types, sample properties) of the user's isolated graph — useful before composing a query.
